hypothesis: Observed inference-call fingerprints bind numeric reports to actual input rows and output values even when ordinary dimension, ID uniqueness and probability-sum checks pass.

comparators.name: ordinary_validation
comparators.description: check_array/finite, shape, unique evaluation IDs, valid probability normalization and class-to-argmax relationship; does not call model or inspect recorded outputs

comparators.name: privileged_direct_comparison
comparators.description: one-to-one equality of reported values, input rows, and IDs to the actual inference call, plus original estimator class order; has the same trusted access as output witness

guardrails: All output calls are explicit benchmark pipeline calls, not initiated by the observer.
No model repairs, refits, automatic acceptance or quality certification.
Hashes are internally consistent fingerprints, not independent proof of origin or estimator identity.
A correct record may correspond to a badly trained or incorrect model.
Each dataset shares scenarios; n cases are correlated and not independent real-world incidents.
A comparator with equally privileged access to actual inference output can detect the same mismatches.
Full-batch input matching is required; transformed features and unselected multiple records are reported unknown.
Numeric outputs only: string class predictions are unknown until a typed adapter supports them.
No unseen incident detection sensitivity or publication superiority claims.
